headline: Brazil Ibovespa Drops Below 167,000 Points on Domestic Fiscal Concerns
summary: Brazil's benchmark Ibovespa index slipped 0.69% to 166,376 points, capping a 3.53% weekly loss as investors grappled with fiscal and political uncertainty alongside global risk aversion.
why: The B3 Ibovespa index tracks the largest Brazilian equities, which are sensitive to domestic fiscal trajectory and foreign capital flows.

impacts.name: Ibovespa
impacts.why: Persistent worries over Brazil's fiscal deficit and government spending drove sustained index selling.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Equities in São Paulo dropped amid ongoing domestic fiscal worries and a cautious tone ahead of a holiday weekend.
